title: Basic IP Configuration and Ping Test

concepts: Subnet mask determines network vs host
Same subnet required for Layer 2 communication

errors.solution: Check same subnet, mask, and cable lights.
Generate traffic with ping; otherwise table stays empty.

questions.question: Why can't different-subnet PCs ping without a router?

questions.question: What does 255.255.255.0 tell the host?
questions.solution: First 24 bits are network; last 8 bits are host addresses.
